result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane boulevard intersection with a high posted speed limit of 40 mph. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the scale of the roadway and long crossing distances create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: High Speed Limit
hazards.description: A posted speed limit of 40 mph significantly increases the risk of fatality in the event of a pedestrian collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible on the speed limit sign on the right side of the roadway.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane nature of the boulevard requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing transverse crosswalk markings are faded, making the crossing less conspicuous to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: On the pavement in the immediate foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for drivers and clearly define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Enhance the existing median with a raised refuge island and cut-through to allow pedestrians to cross the wide boulevard in two stages.

interventions.title: Speed Limit Reduction
interventions.description: Lower the posted speed limit to 25 or 30 mph to reduce the severity of potential crashes and improve overall safety.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road in a residential area with a signalized intersection that lacks marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals. While a sidewalk and curb ramp are present on the near corner, the overall environment is dominated by vehicle throughput, requiring pedestrians to cross a significant distance without a refuge.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge or mid-point protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: Despite the presence of traffic signals and curb ramps, there are no painted markings to define a pedestrian path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, significantly reducing exposure risk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on the remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile paving in a residential setting. However, the wide roadway creates a long crossing distance for pedestrians, increasing exposure to vehicular traffic at a signalized junction.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time in the roadway, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk but no signalized control for pedestrians. While sidewalks are present and buffered by green space, the long crossing distance and lack of active traffic management create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center mid-ground at the zebra crossing

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: The crossing relies solely on paint and signage without signals or physical speed reduction measures on a high-capacity road.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible longitudinal cracking and patching in the roadway surface could affect vehicle braking or pedestrian footing.
